answer: In the PoA graph, each interaction updates a reciprocity-weighted EigenTrust matrix, while reputation decays exponentially with a fixed temporal half-life, so an identity must deliver sustained, honestly corroborated service to retain influence. A freshly spawned sybil begins near the reputation nadir, has near-zero eigenvector centrality, and lacks trusted transitive paths; whether posing as saffron or ivory, it cannot accumulate sufficient weight to pass consensus.
